summary: Verified aptitude no longer terminates the interview flow. Logged in as mocktest@valuevade.test, applied to J.P. Morgan (attempt eabfed6f-7f9d-495f-9500-ce85a63d6f28), submitted application form (why_firm, why_er, achievement, cover_note), advanced to aptitude intro, started test (polled ~15s), deliberately scored 0/12 by answering only 2 questions with option A. On the result screen: pill correctly shows 'Round complete' (rendered uppercase via CSS but source string is 'Round complete'), score is 0% (0/12), sub-copy reads 'Score recorded. Final decision revealed after all rounds.', NO 'Below cutoff' / 'Cutoff cleared' text, CTA button reads exactly 'Continue to HR Interview' (NOT 'See the final decision'). Clicking Continue advanced to the HR / Behavioural round with the interviewer question rendered and a 0/4-answered progress indicator — did NOT jump to any decision/rejection screen. Pre-test intro copy verified to say 'Reference score: 40%. Your score is recorded — the final selection decision is revealed after all rounds are complete' with no terminal 'Score below it and this process ends here' wording. All 3 behaviour verifications and the regression check pass.
critical_code_review_comments: AptitudeStage.jsx result view still keeps 'passed' semantics implicitly (backend still returns `passed`). Consider removing unused `passed` from the response payload later since UI no longer branches on it, to avoid confusion for future maintainers.

The 'Continue to Online Aptitude Test' interstitial button after application submit does not appear to have a dedicated data-testid — adding one (e.g. `application-continue-btn`) would tighten automated coverage between stages.
seed_data_creation: Used existing attempt eabfed6f-7f9d-495f-9500-ce85a63d6f28 which is now at behavioural stage after this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The mocktest user's J.P. Morgan attempt (eabfed6f-7f9d-495f-9500-ce85a63d6f28) is now progressed to the HR/behavioural stage after a 0% aptitude score. If retesting the aptitude→behavioural transition, either wipe the attempt or create a new firm attempt. Data-testids used successfully: firm-apply-jpmorgan, application-field-{why_firm|why_er|achievement|cover_note}, application-submit-btn, aptitude-intro, aptitude-start-btn, aptitude-test, aptitude-q-{i}-opt-{oi}, aptitude-submit-btn, aptitude-result, aptitude-score, aptitude-continue-btn. Note: pill text is CSS-uppercased via tailwind `uppercase` class — assert on lowercase 'Round complete' by reading source (data-testid=aptitude-result contains it), not on inner_text.
